recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Revisit only if publisher output again appends summary glyphs to ElementDefinition.short or description text instead of rendering them in the table Flags column.
issue_request: FHIR-3014 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for an Initial Draft complaint that paragraph-sign-looking symbols appeared at the end of several short descriptions. The accepted direction was to keep summary membership visible, but make the marker clearer and move/document it with the table view rather than leaving it at the end of XML-style descriptions.
initial_application: The historical application is SVN revision 3245, imported as git commit b120d06e7b5e898e498bdef1a4fd58a48bbf30fa, whose message says it removed the summary marker from the XML view and added the table-view legend/description. The Jira comments also record that same SVN revision.
additional_context: source/documentation.html links the current Conformance Rules and Resource Definitions pages. source/formats.html documents the logical table, explains the Flags column, and defines the Sigma flag as the summary-set marker. source/conformance-rules.html examples show summary markers in the Flags column, and a StructureDefinition source search found no short values containing the old paragraph marker or the current Sigma marker. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current source preserves the intended summary indication and avoids the reported placement at the end of short descriptions.
